import json
import unittest


class TestNexus149JsonUtf8(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_chinese_dict_roundtrip(self):
        original = {
            "任务": "对话链路部署验收",
            "状态": "通过",
            "数据": {"序号": 149, "说明": "JSON 中文 UTF-8 往返测试"},
            "列表": ["中文", "emoji-无", "符号：，。！？"],
        }

        raw = json.dumps(original, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        restored = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))

        self.assertEqual(restored, original)
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
        self.assertIn("任务", text)
        self.assertNotIn("\\u4e", text)
        print("NEXUS_149_WORKER_OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
